source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yaralamalar için ödenmesi gereken karşılık veya bedeldir. Malzeme bu kullanımı genel adak ya da uyarı alanından ayırır; küçük ve büyük yaralar, tek yaraya düşen bedel, kemiği açığa çıkaran yara örneği ve farklı teknik adlandırma notu bu sınırı destekler.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çok dallı bir yapı gösterir: tehlikeyi bildirerek sakındırma, kişinin kendine adak yükümlülüğü koyması ve yaralama için ödenmesi gereken karşılık ayrı çekirdeklerdir. Dallar, uyarı iletişimi, gönüllü bağlanma ve hukuki bedel eksenlerinde ayrılır.

text.arabic_uthmani: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا

baseline.text: Dosdoğru; katından gelecek şiddetli bir azapla uyarması ve iyi işler yapan inananlara güzel bir ödül bulunduğunu müjdelemesi için.

findings.text: Kitabın doğrultması, uyarıyı işiten kişinin bilinçli biçimde bozulmayı gideren işler yapmasına uzanan bir eylem düzeni kurar.
Buradaki güzel ödül, yalnız hoş görüneni değil, aldatıcı güzellik sınavından geçerek ahlaki değeri doğrulanmış iyiyi belirtir.
Kitabın dosdoğru oluşu, uyarı ile müjdeyi ve bunların sonuçlarını yerli yerinde tutan koruyucu bir yönetim işlevi de görür.

activation_trace.role: Straightness, equilibrium, and right measure supply the governing calibration.
Warning that frightens in order to awaken caution supplies the negative signal.
News that opens the complexion with joy supplies the positive signal.
Purposeful action makes the recipient response enacted rather than merely assented to.
Repair opposed to corruption gives the actions their operative criterion.
A return for work closes the action-and-consequence loop.

changed_reading.after: An upright norm operates through warning and promise to turn perception into intentional repair and returned benefit.
changed_reading.before: The focus merely juxtaposes punishment and reward.

baseline_models.mechanism: Straight calibration produces two coordinated signals: danger awakens caution, while favorable news opens trust toward intentional anti-corruption work and a fitting return.

activation_trace.role: Guardianship and sustained care make the paired affects a maintained pedagogy.
Overpowering force supplies the threat-side contraction.
Tight binding and strengthened fastening intensify that contraction.
Joyful news opening the visible surface supplies release and renewed receptivity.
Heart-rest, security, and trust identify the inward state restored by the promise.

changed_reading.after: Warning tightens attention and promise restores secure openness, preserving responsive agency between alarm and reassurance.
changed_reading.before: Warning creates fear and good news adds a separate pleasant emotion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Severe force binds and contracts attention, whereas good news visibly opens the person and faith settles the heart; the pair regulates tension and release rather than delivering unrelated reports.

activation_trace.role: Intended action supplies the deliberate labor of the mechanism.
Repair against corruption specifies what the labor accomplishes.
Compensation returning from work links consequence to the performed repair.
Beneficent, well-made action makes the return itself an extension of good doing.

changed_reading.after: The reward is the fitting beneficial continuation of purposeful repair.
changed_reading.before: The good reward is an externally attached prize.

baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional anti-corruption work and a beneficent return form a repair economy in which the return continues the quality of the act rather than functioning as arbitrary payment.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and right measure anchor the focus in normative integrity.
Caused descent and delivery supply the transmission path whose integrity is maintained.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the durable medium being calibrated.
Deviation of meaning supplies the expressly negated failure mode.

changed_reading.after: It names an integrity-preserving written standard whose undistorted transmission makes warning and promise reliable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivery, organized writing, and negated semantic deviation turn the focus's uprightness into transmission integrity: warning and promise are two applications of an undistorted written standard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, written organization, and negated semantic deviation; I infer that qawm's straightness preserves textual integrity and directs its two outputs. A live alternative is that قَيِّمًا is only a general evaluative adjective.
structural_cues: 18:1 supplies a written antecedent and negates عوج immediately before 18:2 opens with قَيِّمًا.

activation_trace.role: Compensation for work supplies the initially bounded return.
Stable remaining with expectancy turns the return into a sustained state.
Unbounded duration removes the terminal edge of the work-return cycle.

changed_reading.after: Reward is an enduring good condition that receives and continuously holds the workers.
changed_reading.before: Reward is a favorable item transferred after work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The work-return relation expands from a discrete payment into durable inhabitation: the good return is something recipients remain within without temporal exhaustion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remaining-in-it and indefinite duration; I take the pronoun as continuing the good reward and infer inhabitation rather than repeated wages. A live alternative is a purely locative consequence with no change to the reward model.
structural_cues: 18:3's فِيهِ grammatically presents the promised good return as a state or domain in which recipients remain.

activation_trace.role: Caution-awakening warning supplies the intervention before false claims settle.
Saying or attributing what is not so supplies the malformed claim operation.
Knowledge as disclosure is syntactically absent, exposing the claim's missing warrant.
Contradiction of truth names the output produced by the unwarranted claim.
Guessing speech about the unseen supplies a later recurrence of the same epistemic defect.
Sharp verbal disputation shows the social amplification of unsupported claims.

changed_reading.after: It also interrupts the present production and circulation of authoritative-sounding claims without knowledge.
changed_reading.before: The severe warning concerns an unspecified future harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning becomes claim-quality control: speech without disclosed knowledge exits as false attribution, and later unseen-number guessing hardens into verbal contest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a claim pipeline and a later guess-dispute recurrence; I infer that the focus warning protects epistemic and social integrity, not only bodies. A live alternative is that these are separate condemned topics linked only by punishment.
structural_cues: 18:4-5 repeat warning, saying, absent knowledge, mouth-output, and lie; 18:22 repeats saying around unseen-number guesses and limits dispute.

activation_trace.role: Awakening caution defines the warning's legitimate causal reach.
Care and guardianship anchor the warning in maintained responsibility rather than compulsion.
Killing oneself from grief supplies the overreach produced when warning is treated as total control.
Heart-settling assent remains the hearer's internal act and marks the agency boundary.
Grief over what is missed supplies the affect that must be contained.

changed_reading.after: Upright warning fully addresses the hearer yet preserves the agency boundary that keeps care from becoming coercion or self-destruction.
changed_reading.before: Successful warning is measured by whether it produces belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning can awaken caution but cannot replace inward assent; upright guardianship therefore includes a boundary against the messenger consuming himself when hearers do not trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, non-belief, and self-destructive grief; I infer a limit between communicative responsibility and control of assent. A live alternative is only personal consolation, without revising the warning mechanism.
structural_cues: 18:6 places the hearers' non-belief between the messenger's self-exhaustion and grief.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption anchors the changed account of good work.
Displayed beautification supplies the attractive but nonfinal surface.
Testing that reveals condition turns the surface into an assay of action.
The split root's parallel trial image reinforces disclosure of what action actually is.
Desirable quality modifies work here and links the test to the focus's good return.
Purposeful action is the variable being disclosed by the trial.
Cutting and uprooting supply the removal phase that tests whether value depended on display.

changed_reading.after: Good works are quality-bearing repairs revealed under an attractive but removable surface and measured by what remains when display is stripped.
changed_reading.before: Good works are a stable checklist performed within a stable world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Made adornment exposes the quality of action, then the adorned surface is cut back to barrenness; good work is therefore repair whose quality survives surface loss rather than behavior that preserves display.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adornment, assay, best work, and stripping; I infer that صالحات names durable repair disclosed by loss of surface. A live alternative is that the حسن/عمل repetition is verbal emphasis without a shared quality mechanism.
structural_cues: 18:7 asks which are best in work and 18:8 immediately reverses adornment into stripped ground.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering severity supplies one operation associated with the proximal source.
Joy-opening news anchors the paired beneficial operation.
Tender mercy supplies the positive content placed beside the repeated proximal formula.
Preparation and repair for an undertaking make mercy operational rather than merely affective.
Straight guidance away from error gives the prepared benefit its directional aim.
Practical utility and benefit show the positive operation materializing as usable support.

changed_reading.after: Severity and prepared mercy issue from one near source as coordinated operations toward different recipient conditions.
changed_reading.before: The proximal divine source qualifies severe force, while good news is a separate softer channel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same proximal-source formula that marks severe force in the focus recurs beside mercy, preparation, and right direction; warning and benefit become destination-specific operations from one near source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated proximal formula plus mercy, preparation, direction, and utility; I infer source symmetry between severity and care. A live alternative is a lexical echo that does not rebalance the focus pair.
structural_cues: The branchless root ل د ن occurs at 18:2 word 6 and 18:10 word 10; it is used only as a structural recurrence, not as a fabricated branch citation.
18:10 and 18:16 pair mercy with preparation for the recipients' affair.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action anchors the transition from believer identity to enacted response.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward starting state.
Fastening the heart supplies stability under the coming public action.
Resolve and rising into an undertaking convert uprightness into enacted stance.
Withdrawal to a distinct side supplies protective spatial action when the surrounding practice conflicts.

changed_reading.after: Belief becomes legible as a maintained trajectory from inward assent to stable public stance and protective action.
changed_reading.before: Believers are a settled class who subsequently accumulate good deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Belief moves from inward trust through a fastened heart into rising, speaking, and protective separation; working repair is a public and spatial posture, not a static membership label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence from assent to stabilized stance and separation; I infer it as one action path instantiating يعملون الصالحات. A live alternative is that these episodes exemplify courage without defining the focus's work relation.
structural_cues: 18:13-16 sequence belief, increased guidance, heart-fastening, standing speech, and withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and preservation anchor the maintenance function.
Straightness supplies the stable aim that corrective motions preserve.
Inclining and turning aside supply a controlled deviation that protects rather than corrupts.
Cutting across and passing to a side supplies bounded lateral exposure.
A widened interval supplies the protected spatial buffer.
Reversing a thing from one face to another supplies periodic corrective motion.

changed_reading.after: Maintained rightness may require controlled angles and reversals that preserve a stable axis under changing exposure.
changed_reading.before: Uprightness means remaining fixed and avoiding every deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preservation is achieved through angled light, lateral passage, an open interior interval, and repeated turning; upright guardianship can be dynamic correction around a stable aim rather than immobility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deviation, side-passage, buffering, and reversal; I supply the arrow that these motions serve preservation and so analogize qawm's care. A live alternative is that the scene is only physical protection with no semantic feedback into قَيِّمًا.
structural_cues: 18:17-18 preserve the sleepers through angled light, an interior gap, and repeated right-left turning.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the practical care model.
Directed sight and discernment supply careful selection.
Purity and soundness specify the sought quality of provision.
An apportioned gift supplies the material support brought back to the group.
Fineness, smallness, and concealment supply the low-visibility manner of action.

changed_reading.after: A good work can be quiet operational care: discerning what is sound, provisioning others, and minimizing harmful exposure.
changed_reading.before: Good works are publicly recognizable acts rewarded after completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action becomes discriminating, purity-seeking provisioning performed with low visibility; repair includes competent care for bodies and exposure risk, not only conspicuous moral performance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concrete survival workflow; I infer it as a local instantiation of صالحات because it repairs need while limiting danger. A live alternative is that it remains situational logistics without broader ethical force.
structural_cues: 18:19 sequences looking, selecting the purest food, bringing provision, subtle conduct, and avoiding detection.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering severity anchors the danger as coercive force.
Rising over and overcoming supplies the captors' control condition.
Return after departure supplies the forced reversal.
An established communal way supplies the norm into which they would be reabsorbed.
Flourishing and lasting success supply what the coercive return destroys.
Unbounded duration makes the loss the negative mirror of the abiding reward.

changed_reading.after: Its severity includes forced reversion: agency and repaired orientation are captured by a hostile social norm, reversing the path toward abiding good.
changed_reading.before: Severe force is an externally inflicted penalty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Severe force becomes social capture: overpowering returns the believers into an imposed collective way, and that reversal cancels enduring flourishing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercive reversal into a communal way and enduring failure; I infer this as a concrete social mechanism of the focus's severity. A live alternative is that the warning concerns only physical attack, with forced return as a separate risk.
structural_cues: 18:20 gives a causal sequence: discovery, overpowering, forced return, and permanent loss of flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action anchors the focus's deed relation.
Producing an act supplies the asserted future agency that is about to be qualified.
Willing directed toward the thing supplies contingency beyond the actor's declaration.
Recovering what was absent from attention supplies a repair operation after lapse.
Loss from memory supplies the interruption that makes action revisable.
Nearness supplies comparative progress rather than a claim of completed arrival.
Straight guidance away from error supplies the trajectory's corrected direction.

changed_reading.after: Good working includes holding plans contingently, repairing forgetfulness, and repeatedly seeking a nearer right course.
changed_reading.before: Those who work good possess a stable capacity to execute intended acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Future doing is corrected by willing, remembrance after forgetting, and renewed guidance toward a nearer right course; good action is a revisable trajectory rather than autonomous possession of tomorrow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asserted action, contingency, lapse, repair, and comparative direction; I infer a process model for يعملون rather than a one-time credential. A live alternative is a narrow etiquette of future speech.
structural_cues: 18:23's confident tomorrow-declaration is immediately qualified in 18:24 by willing, remembering after lapse, and asking for nearer guidance.

activation_trace.role: Right measure anchors the final calibration.
Disclosure to the knower supplies comprehensive epistemic access.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain unavailable to ordinary estimation.
Participation is expressly denied, excluding a co-owner of the final decision.
Judgment between parties supplies the decisive assignment of outcomes.

changed_reading.after: Readers answer the norm through work, but its final warning and reward calibration belongs to unshared judgment with access to what they cannot see.
changed_reading.before: The upright norm is a scale that readers can fully administer and use to estimate deserts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Comprehensive knowledge of hidden duration and judgment without a partner locate final calibration outside human speculation; recipients perform repair but do not own the scale that assigns warning and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden knowledge and judgment without participation; I infer that the focus's upright warning-return scale is administered by that comprehensive knower. A live alternative is a general omniscience claim with no feedback into the focus mechanism.
structural_cues: 18:26 closes the window by contrasting human uncertainty about duration with divine knowledge, sight, hearing, and unshared judgment.

remaining_uncertainties: The exact antecedent and syntax of the focus-initial adjective depend on 18:1, so the focus-only baseline left its bearer unspecified.
ل د ن has no branch inventory in the packet and was used only as a structural recurrence.
The dynamic-maintenance, splint, and ledger readings are cross-domain analogies, not lexical substitutions.
The حسن/عمل and ل د ن recurrences may be thematic echoes rather than deliberate mechanism links.
strongest_changes: قَيِّمًا became an integrity-preserving written norm whose paired outputs govern claim production as well as conduct.
The repeated branchless ل د ن structure made severe warning and prepared mercy source-symmetric rather than separate jurisdictions.
The cave's angled light and repeated turning activated dynamic maintenance: controlled deviation can preserve uprightness.
Working صالحات became tested, discreet, and contingent repair rather than a static merit class.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support a two-channel regulatory mechanism linking textual calibration, affect, action, and return; the context repeatedly materializes it as speech discipline, trial, bounded care, refuge, turning, provisioning, coercive reversal, and corrected planning.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and restored alignment supply the target condition.
Repair against corruption supplies the healing operation.
Setting a broken bone even when it heals on a bend supplies the material image for reparative return.
Bentness supplies the deformation image, while the source syntax negates it in the delivered text.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the good return continues repair like a splint that re-sets fracture toward alignment, even while acknowledging prior bend.
changed_reading.before: Reward pays for behavior that has already repaired corruption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates أجر's bone-setting branch instead of its ordinary compensation branch. It remains anchored through focus-root links among straightness, anti-corruption repair, and the good return, with 18:1 supplying negated crookedness; downstream prose must label it a material analogy and must not translate أجر as splinting.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and pricing supply an explicit scale for making consequences legible.
Self-imposed obligation supplies a distant liability image without redefining the form-IV warning.
The worker's wage supplies the labor-side account.
Compensation and hire supply the return-side account.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upright discourse makes liability, labor, and fitting return legible as entries on one moral valuation scale.
changed_reading.before: Warning and reward are affective announcements without a shared accounting image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a legal-economic cross-domain activation: qawm's valuation, nadhr's self-imposed obligation, labor's wage, and ajr's compensation form a ledger image. Every element is focus-anchored, but the nadhr branch is form-distant from warning; downstream prose must present the model as an analogy of legible obligation and return, not as lexical substitution.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rectification becomes intentional practice.** `ع م ل` B001 (“intentional doing and work”) and `ص ل ح` B001 (“soundness against corruption”) are joined, then echoed in 18:30, 88, 107, 110. I infer that the upright book enables a sequence from warning/hearing to chosen repair. The reward is attached not to passive affiliation but to acts intentionally restoring soundness.
2. **Goodness is tested before it is rewarded.** `ح س ن` B001 (“goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness”) recurs as “best in work” at 18:7 and as difficult beneficial outcomes at 18:81, 88. I infer that `حسنًا` names morally verified good, not merely pleasant appearance. The announcement anticipates a surah-wide test of deceptive beauty.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repeated trust–sound-work formulas at 18:30, 88, and 107 revealed this as the surah’s durable action grammar.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Uprightness as sustaining governance.** `ق و م/B008` gives `قَيِّمًا` straightness, while `ق و م/B004` adds care, guardianship, and preservation. The preceding negated `عِوَج` (18:1) supplies the correction cue; the balanced warning/glad-tiding clauses and the enduring stay of 18:3 supply a managed two-outcome structure. I infer that textual uprightness is what keeps consequences properly ordered. The adjective therefore reads as both straight and regulative: the book stands over the moral system it announces.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:3 made the book’s guardianship durable, while 18:4–5 showed its upright ordering working across opposite announced outcomes and false claims.

words.gloss_range: upright, self-standing, corrective quality of the Book, carried across the 18:1 to 18:2 boundary
words.prose: The opening word {{ar:قَيِّمًۭا}} ({{tr:qayyiman}}) is not a fresh, free-standing adjective. Its accusative case reaches back to the Book in 18:1, so the ayah boundary stays grammatically transparent while the prior denial of crookedness is completed by positive uprightness. The q-w-m field makes that uprightness feel self-standing, sustaining, and evaluative: the Book is not only straight but becomes the standard from which warning and glad tidings can proceed. Its intensive adjectival shape makes that straightness a durable maintained quality; variant and parsing evidence is useful as contrast, but locally the circumstantial reading keeps the Book itself as the bearer of this quality. The geminated sound and opening -an ending also start the ayah's accusative cadence, later picked up by threat and reward terms.
words.root_gloss_range: standing, uprightness, establishing, sustaining order, valuation, and related branches; the local adjective selects durable uprightness and standard-setting

topics.headline: cross-ayah accusative and competing parses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word of 18:2 still depends on the Book statement in 18:1 and completes negated crookedness with named uprightness.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as accusative circumstantial from the Book in 18:1; badal and naʿt readings remain useful apparatus but do not erase the cross-boundary dependence.

topics.headline: uprightness as sustaining standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees uprightness as a standard-setting and sustaining quality from which warning and promise can be sorted.
topics.reason: The local adjective licenses uprightness and evaluative standard; broader q-w-m branches and divine-title comparisons are retained only as range and echo, including the guidance formula at 17:9 and same-surah returns at 18:14, 18:15, 18:36, 18:77, and 18:105.

topics.headline: intensive adjective and variant contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local form presents maintained uprightness, while variants show the pressure without replacing the standard surface.
topics.reason: The local form is a qualitative adjective; variant evidence may expose interpretive pressure but does not govern the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: uprightness before mission verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning and glad tidings launched from an already-stated Book-quality rather than from a neutral opening.
topics.reason: The word precedes the purpose verbs and supplies the platform from which both functions proceed.

topics.headline: tight opening sound and -an thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the opening adjective join the ayah’s chain of accusative -an endings.
topics.reason: The geminated sound and tanwīn are local surface facts that support the opening quality and connect later threat and reward nouns.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām attached to the first mission verb
words.prose: The particle {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the Book-quality statement into mission. Because it governs {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}), the warning is marked as purpose, not as a detached report. Its bound form also compresses purpose into the very start of the warning verb, so function emerges directly from the preceding uprightness.

topics.headline: purpose particle governing warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns from what the Book is to what it is for.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as purposive lām governing the following subjunctive verb; the bound form fuses purpose to the warning action.

words.gloss_range: Form IV warning: causing awareness of feared danger within the purpose frame
words.prose: The verb {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}) is the first governed mission verb. Its subjunctive form sits under {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), and its silent 3ms subject can keep divine agent and revealed Book layered from 18:1. The local Form IV selects advance warning, not the vow branch of the root: it causes awareness of danger before the feared force arrives. Structurally it opens the compact warning side that will be balanced by {{ar:يُبَشِّرَ}} ({{tr:yubashshira}}), with the same warning/glad-tiding mission pair returning at 18:56. The dental-dhāl release into the following hamzated force noun gives the warning-to-object transition an abrupt acoustic break.
words.root_gloss_range: warning, notice of danger, and vow or obligation branches; the local Form IV selects warning while the vow branch remains background pressure

topics.headline: governed warning with layered subject and omitted recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warning is a governed purpose with a layered silent subject, while the warned-of force is foregrounded over the audience.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under the purpose lām; attachment evidence leaves the 3ms subject ambiguous between divine agent and Book while making the object explicit.

topics.headline: Form IV advance warning, not vow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb as causing awareness of danger before impact, with the vow branch present only as root background.
topics.reason: The local Form IV selects warning or notification of danger; Form I vow and mutual-warning branches are contrastive range, not the local sense.

topics.headline: first pole of warning and glad tidings

topics.reason: The warning verb is coordinated with the glad-tiding verb under one purpose frame, and the same paired mission vocabulary returns at 18:56.

topics.headline: warning sound before force noun

topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the transition from the warning verb into its object.

words.gloss_range: warned-of severe force, hardship, and misery as the overt object of warning
words.prose: In {{ar:بَأْسًۭا}} ({{tr:baʾsan}}), the warning has an overt object before it has an overt warned audience. The noun names the force or hardship warned about, and the b-ʾ-s field lets force, misery, and blame converge rather than leaving a neutral danger term. Its event-noun shape and indefiniteness keep the threat open in extent, while its pairing with {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) joins a recognizable severe-force formula also echoed in 33:18 and 48:16; within the surah the root later turns toward blame language at 18:29 and 18:50.
words.root_gloss_range: force, might, punishment, wretchedness, and blame; the local noun selects the punitive-force branch with misery-valence

topics.headline: overt warned-of object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause foregrounds the thing warned about before naming either audience or source.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as direct object of the warning verb; the source phrase follows only after the object is specified.

topics.headline: force and misery in one warning noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the warning object is punitive force that produces misery, not a neutral danger label.
topics.reason: The root field supports force, hardship, wretchedness, and blame, and the following adjective intensifies that negative valence.

topics.headline: event noun with open extent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning names an unspecified force-event rather than a named punisher or quantified penalty.
topics.reason: The gerund and tanwīn keep the threatened force event-like and open in extent; the hamza gives the noun a clipped local impact.

topics.headline: severe-force formula and local root thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the warned force as part of a recurring severe-consequence formula that also seeds later surah blame language.
topics.reason: The b-ʾ-s plus sh-d-d pairing is recurrent, with formula parallels at 33:18 and 48:16, and same-surah b-ʾ-s returns at 18:29 and 18:50.

words.gloss_range: tight, hard, intense severity modifying the warned force
words.prose: The adjective {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) is locked by agreement to {{ar:بَأْسًۭا}} ({{tr:baʾsan}}); the severity belongs to the warned force, not to the later source phrase. The sh-d-d image of tying, tightening, and strengthening turns severity into constrictive pressure, and the quality-form presents that intensity as intrinsic rather than comparative. Matched indefiniteness leaves both the force noun and its modifier qualitatively open. Its local pairing with {{ar:بَأْسًۭا}} ({{tr:baʾsan}}) seals the warning core before the phrase of divine origin arrives, while later surah use at 18:82 keeps the intensity root in play. The hamza, shīn, and dāl texture also roughens the phrase at the point where severity is named.
words.root_gloss_range: binding, tightening, strengthening, and severity; the local adjective transfers tightness into abstract intensity

topics.headline: severity bound to the force noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees intensity attached directly to the warned force before the source phrase appears.
topics.reason: Agreement in case and indefiniteness binds the adjective to the force noun; local order seals the warning core before origin.

topics.headline: tight-binding root image as abstract severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels severity as constrictive pressure rather than a generic intensifier.
topics.reason: The root image of binding and tightening is locally transferred to abstract severity; the qualitative form makes intensity intrinsic rather than comparative.

topics.headline: matched indefiniteness with the force noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both noun and adjective leave the threat qualitatively open.
topics.reason: The adjective mirrors the noun’s indefinite accusative marking.

topics.headline: severity motif and established pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adjective as part of a recurring severity field, not decorative wording.
topics.reason: The local pairing with the force noun is strongly licensed, and the root recurs later in the surah at 18:82.

topics.headline: harsh consonant texture

topics.reason: The sound cluster belongs to the local severe-force phrase.

words.gloss_range: source/origin preposition for the following divine-proximity phrase
words.prose: The preposition {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) pivots the warning from what is feared to where it comes from. The local phrase selects source or origin rather than a partitive sense, and its placement after {{ar:بَأْسًۭا}} ({{tr:baʾsan}}) {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}) makes origin a late qualifier of the whole warning beat. The nasal-to-l sound also binds the particle tightly to the following proximity term.

topics.headline: origin rather than partitive source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning beat turn from the severe force to its divine origin.
topics.reason: The preposition selects source/origin with the following proximity noun; attachment may shade whether it qualifies warning or force, but partitive reading is not local.

topics.headline: nasal binding into proximity phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the source particle bind into the following proximity expression.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the source phrase.

words.gloss_range: from His immediate presence, with the suffix resuming the divine referent
words.prose: The phrase {{ar:لَدُنْهُ}} ({{tr:ladunhu}}) completes the warning side by tracing the severe force to His immediate presence. The suffix resumes the divine referent from 18:1, so the source is not the Book as an independent power but the One who sent it down. The ladun expression is a marked, close-source term rather than ordinary nearness; variant vocalizations and cadence affect its weight, but not its source function. The same from-near-Him formula appears in special-source contexts such as 18:65 and 3:8, here specialized for warning rather than knowledge or mercy.

topics.headline: suffix fixes divine source

topics.headline: marked immediate-source term

topics.headline: variant vowel weight around source term

topics.reason: The variants alter syllable and pronoun weight while preserving the same source relation.

topics.headline: from-near-Him formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the source phrase as a special divine-origin register, here applied to warning.
topics.reason: The phrase echoes special-source contexts such as 18:65 and 3:8, while local placement delays origin until after the severe force is named.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that joins the second purpose verb to the first
words.prose: The conjunction {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the promise side grammatically coequal with the warning side under the same purpose frame. It coordinates rather than backgrounding the second verb as a circumstance, and its attachment to {{ar:يُبَشِّرَ}} ({{tr:yubashshira}}) makes the turn from compact threat to expanded promise feel continuous rather than restarted.

topics.headline: second mission coordinated under one purpose frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning and glad tidings as coordinated functions under one mission frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction links two subjunctive purpose verbs; coordination is the local reading, not circumstantial backgrounding.

topics.headline: hinge from compact threat to expanded promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from a short severe-force notice into a longer person-directed promise.
topics.reason: The conjunction stands exactly between the warning unit and the expanded glad-tidings clause.

words.gloss_range: Form II glad-tiding: formal delivery of good news to qualified recipients
words.prose: The verb {{ar:يُبَشِّرَ}} ({{tr:yubashshira}}) is the positive mission counterpart to {{ar:يُنذِرَ}} ({{tr:yundhira}}). It remains subjunctive under the first purpose lām and shares the same silent subject, but its Form II surface focuses on delivering glad tidings to others. The doubled shīn gives that delivery verb extra audible weight, matching the Form II mechanism of active transmission. The b-sh-r field lets good news carry the image of joy made visible on human surfaces, which fits its direct object {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}). Variant evidence shows possible shifts toward rejoicing, causing gladness, or independent assertion, but the standard reading keeps communicative mission parallel to warning. From this verb the clause expands through recipient, qualifier, and promised content; the warning/glad-tiding office recurs at 18:56 and in broader messenger formulas.
words.root_gloss_range: skin or human surface, visible joy, and good-news delivery; the local Form II selects communicative glad tidings

topics.headline: second subjunctive under first lām

topics.reason: The standard subjunctive keeps the verb in the purpose chain; the indicative variant is contrastive and does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: Form II communicative glad tidings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices good news as delivered communication whose effect is directed toward human recipients, while variant forms show rejected local alternatives.
topics.reason: The local Form II focuses on formal delivery of glad tidings; Form I rejoicing and Form IV causing gladness remain variant contrasts, not the selected surface.

topics.headline: promise pole of warning/glad-tiding pair

topics.reason: The b-sh-r and n-dh-r roots form the paired mission here and recur at 18:56; same-surah b-sh-r also reconnects with human status at 18:110.

topics.headline: glad-tiding clause expands after the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise side opens into recipient, qualifier, and content rather than stopping at a compact object.
topics.reason: The following structure expands from verb to object, relative clause, and content clause.

topics.headline: doubled sound of delivery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the delivery verb carry extra weight in the promise turn.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle class of believers as the human recipients of glad tidings
words.prose: The object {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}) makes the promise human and bounded. The definite sound plural names a recognized class, while the active participle presents faith as a continuing trust/security identity rather than a completed past act. The following {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) immediately narrows that broad faith category by enacted sound deeds, so the recipients are not left as a bare title. Same-surah links at 18:29 and 18:107 make this believer category part of a larger arc of choice and reward. The internal hamza gives the faith/security noun a small glottal catch inside the promise clause.
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, guarantee, and faith; the local plural participle names an ongoing trust/security identity

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees believers as a trust/security category whose positive valence fits the promised recompense.

topics.headline: ongoing participial identity

topics.headline: believer class narrowed by action

topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the faith/security word marked inside the promise clause.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun that turns the believer noun into an action-defined class
words.prose: The relative pronoun {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) carries {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}) forward into a defining clause. It does more than point back: it packages plural reference with subordination, turning the recipient noun into the ones who do what follows. The promise therefore moves from status to practiced action before it states the reward.

topics.headline: relative pronoun carries believers forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grammar keeps the believers and the following doers identical without repeating the noun.
topics.reason: The plural relative pronoun refers back to the believer object and opens a subordinate clause.

topics.headline: status turns into practiced action

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural work inside the relative clause
words.prose: The verb {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūna}}) makes the believers active agents inside the relative clause. Its indicative imperfect presents ongoing or habitual practice, not another subjunctive purpose and not a one-time completed deed. The ʿ-m-l field gives the action productive labor force, leaning forward toward {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}), and the work-plus-soundness formula returns at 18:30, 18:107, and as a direct command at 18:110.

topics.headline: habitual collective action

topics.headline: work plus soundness through the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the action clause as a formulaic thread that later becomes reward language and final instruction.

words.gloss_range: known class of sound, restorative deeds as the object of the work verb
words.prose: The object {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) completes the believer-defining action unit. The definite feminine plural invokes a known class of sound deeds without listing individual acts, and the ṣ-l-ḥ field makes those acts restorative, reparative, and sound rather than merely conventionally pious. This is the node where work, repair, and reward meet: the same field returns at 18:30, 18:88, 18:107, and 18:110, while the article assimilation makes the deed-class audibly fused to the soundness root.
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, repair, reform, reconciliation, and righteousness; the local plural names deeds by their attained sound quality

topics.headline: known class of sound deeds as object

words.gloss_range: content particle that opens and strengthens the promise proposition
words.prose: The particle {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) opens the actual content of the good news. After {{ar:يُبَشِّرَ}} ({{tr:yubashshira}}), it is read as a content clause rather than a causal explanation, and its scope covers the beneficiary, reward noun, and final adjective. The promise side now shifts from who qualifies to what is assigned to them, with the doubled n-sound giving audible weight to the proposition it fixes.

topics.headline: content clause of glad tidings

topics.headline: doubled n-sound at proposition opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear extra weight at the start of the promise content.

words.gloss_range: beneficiary/allocation lām in the fronted phrase for them
words.prose: The lām {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the fronted beneficiary phrase. It keeps possession and special designation together: the reward is for the qualified believers and allocated to them. Because the phrase precedes {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}), the clause secures the recipients before naming the recompense, blocking a diffuse reward statement detached from its people.

topics.headline: ownership and designation together

topics.reason: The lām governs the pronoun and marks possession, allocation, or special designation in the reward clause.

topics.headline: beneficiary secured before reward noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recipients placed before the recompense, preventing an untethered reward statement.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun form a fronted beneficiary unit before the reward noun appears.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun resuming the qualified believers as beneficiaries
words.prose: The pronoun {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is the compact bridge from the qualified believers into the reward clause. Governed by {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), it makes the recipients beneficiaries without repeating the full noun phrase. The semantic role has shifted: the same group described as doers of sound acts is now carried forward as those for whom recompense is assigned.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes qualified believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise content is explicitly reattached to the same believers qualified by action.
topics.reason: The pronoun refers back to the believer group as modified by the relative clause.

topics.headline: bound pronoun as beneficiary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the doers of sound acts carried compactly into the reward clause as beneficiaries.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the lām, assigning recipient role without repeating the full noun phrase.

words.gloss_range: indefinite recompense noun in the promise clause, wage-like but not locally a hiring request
words.prose: The noun {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}) names the promised thing inside the {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause. Its position after the fronted beneficiary phrase gives a verbless allocation shape: for them is a reward. As a verbal noun it compresses giver, recompensing act, and recipients into one promised noun. The ʾ-j-r field is wage-like recompense tied to work, especially after {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūna}}), though the local form is the reward noun and not a hiring request. Its indefiniteness leaves magnitude open, and its -an ending pairs sonically with the following final adjective; same-surah recurrence at 18:30 and 18:77 seeds a compensation motif.
words.root_gloss_range: wages, hire, lease, recompense, and reward; the local noun selects recompense assigned after work

topics.headline: reward named after beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the promise become grammatically concrete only when the reward noun appears after the fronted beneficiary phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative within the content clause, with the fronted beneficiary phrase forming the allocation frame.

topics.headline: verbal noun compressing recompense roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one noun compress the giver, recompensing act, and recipients.
topics.reason: The maṣdar-like noun can encode the act of recompense abstractly while the clause supplies recipients.

topics.headline: wage-like recompense tied to work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a work-to-recompense arc from ongoing deeds to reward, while the local noun remains reward rather than a hiring negotiation.
topics.reason: The ʾ-j-r field supports wage-like recompense and the work connection; the local form is simple recompense, not a seeking-to-hire derivative.

topics.headline: open reward magnitude and closing cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward magnitude left unspecified while sound pairs it with the final adjective.
topics.reason: Tanwīn leaves the noun open in extent and matches the following adjective cadence.

topics.headline: reward hub and surah compensation motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes reward as the hub tying faith, work, soundness, and beauty into one promise cluster.
topics.reason: The root clusters with the ayah’s faith, work, soundness, and beauty fields and recurs in compensation scenes at 18:30 and 18:77.

words.gloss_range: beautiful and good quality grammatically locked to the reward noun
words.prose: The final word {{ar:حَسَنًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥasanan}}) locks beauty and goodness onto {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}). Its gerund-like form functions adjectivally, making the quality feel substantive rather than a light tag, and its agreement keeps that quality attached to the reward rather than to the recipients or deeds. The ḥ-s-n field does not split aesthetic beauty from moral goodness, so the close promises recompense that is good, beautiful, and excellent. In final position, with matching -an cadence after {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}), it seals the promise side and balances the earlier severe adjective {{ar:شَدِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shadīdan}}); same-surah uses at 18:7, 18:30, and 18:88 keep the excellence field alive.
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, benefit, and moral/aesthetic rightness; the local adjective qualifies the reward

topics.headline: gerund-form adjective locked to reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beauty/goodness is grammatically attached to the reward as a substantive quality.
topics.reason: The word functions as an adjective agreeing with the reward noun, while its gerund-like morphology gives the quality substance.

topics.headline: beauty and moral goodness together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward as beautiful, good, and excellent rather than merely acceptable or comparatively better.
topics.reason: The ḥ-s-n field unites aesthetic beauty, moral goodness, excellence, and benefit; the local form is simple quality, not comparative.

topics.headline: beautiful reward answers severe force and sound deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final quality answer both the severe warning adjective and the earlier sound-deed field.
topics.reason: The final adjective modifies the reward while standing in local contrast to the severe adjective and linking to work and soundness roots.

topics.headline: final quality seal and -an cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close not just on reward, but on reward-quality as the final take-away.
topics.reason: The indefinite adjective mirrors the reward noun, stands at ayah end, and completes the chain of -an endings.

topics.headline: surah-local excellence field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final quality seed a local excellence motif that later touches testing and reward.
topics.reason: The ḥ-s-n field recurs in same-surah contexts at 18:7, 18:30, and 18:88.
